paper_title: First Search for Axion-Like Particles in a Storage Ring Using a Polarized Deuteron Beam
notes: Paper reports first storage-ring ALP search using polarized deuterons at COSY, scanning ALP mass range 4.95-5.02 neV (around 5e-10 eV/c2). Primary result is an upper limit on the oscillating EDM component of the deuteron and its axion coupling constants (gaNgamma to EDM operator). This maps to AxionEDM coupling. However, the provided content cuts off before the final results section (Section IV) and the actual numerical limit values/tables for the oscillating EDM (d_AC in e*cm) or coupling are not present in the extractable text. The Wien filter calibration values (resonance strengths) are instrumental, not the physics limit. No numerical exclusion data points could be reliably extracted.
